description: This file defines API endpoints for report generation and download in a FastAPI application. It includes route handlers that generate reports based on requests, handle errors, and serve report files for download.

methods.name: ReportResponse generate_report( req: ReportRequest, svc: ReportService = get_report_service, )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to generate a report based on the provided dataset filename, columns to include, and format.

methods.name: FileResponse download_report( report_filename: str = Query(..., description="Report filename"), svc: ReportService = get_report_service, )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to download a previously generated report file by filename.
